caveats: Seven plaintiffs (former LMPD Youth Explorer program participants) sued LMPD/Louisville Metro and Boy Scouts of America; multiple consolidated suits but not a class action, so lawsuit_type=civilian. Year filed: LPM and Spectrum say first suit filed March 2017 (Spectrum: March 8, 2017); WDRB in-depth says March 2018 — 2017 used per majority of sources. $3.65M settlement (Nov 2021), mostly paid by BSA's insurer with under $1M from Metro's insurance. Criminal: Spectrum says three officers pleaded guilty to federal charges; WDRB names Kenneth Betts, Brandon Wood, and Bradley Schuhman as convicted of sex-related federal crimes — pleaded_guilty chosen as the more specific mechanism.
